Legendary Collection

Released May 24, 2002 · 110 cards

Legendary Collection is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on May 24, 2002. It has 110 cards. It includes 99 Pokémon, 9 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

8 illustrators worked on Legendary Collection. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (43), Mitsuhiro Arita (33), Kagemaru Himeno (20), Keiji Kinebuchi (10), Christopher Rush (1), Miki Tanaka (1), Shin-ichi Yoshida (1), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (1).
